pages.text: A Canister holds eight buckets of a single fluid and displays its fill level through the glass. A bucket can insert or withdraw fluid directly, provided the stored liquid is compatible.

A nearly full Canister still accepts a full compatible bucket. It takes only the amount needed to reach eight buckets, consumes the filled bucket normally, and loses the excess.$(br2)A completely full Canister rejects insertion; a Canister holding a different liquid rejects mixing.
